rationale: The most recent candle sequence shows deteriorating momentum: price has pulled back from the brief high of $38.84 to close at $38.65, sitting below the session VWAP of $38.87 and threatening the 9-EMA support. The maximum adverse excursion of -0.31% already exceeded the maximum favorable excursion of 0.09%, indicating the trade has not developed as expected, and the broader market context (SPY -0.94%, VIXY +5.42%) adds headwind pressure. With price barely above entry and momentum fading, the risk/reward no longer justifies holding.
